title: OpsIQ Capability Evidence Ledger
purpose: The raw evidence base behind OPSIQ_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.json. Every number here is countable from the repo — not asserted from memory.

requiredCiLane.lane: LANE_B — Local Postgres (throwaway postgres:16 service container)
requiredCiLane.runsOn: push to main / claude/**, and PRs to main
requiredCiLane.verificationMethod: Log inspection: each PR's LANE_B log is grepped to confirm the specific new .db.test.ts executed (e.g. 'recovery-execution-milestone-proof.db.test.ts (11 tests)') — a generic green lane is not accepted.

unwiredNote: These 10 DB simulations exist and pass on disk but are NOT gated on every PR. Their capabilities may be described as 'DB-proven on disk' but NOT as 'CI-gated'. A future pass should either wire them into LANE_B or record them as intentionally out-of-lane.

noLiveAiEvidence.selfReport: 'OPENAI_API_KEY not set — live AI disabled, deterministic path used.'
noLiveAiEvidence.conclusion: No live LLM write-path in any decision/domain flow. All decisions are deterministic rule engines.

noAutonomousActionEvidence.conclusion: OpsIQ proposes; the owner/manager decides and acts. No customer contact, tender submit, spend, discount, or contract is automated.

noRealOutcomeData.conclusion: No repo artifact contains verified real-world business outcome data (money earned, business saved, ROI). All simulations use synthetic/controlled fixtures. Therefore NO outcome claim is supportable.
noRealOutcomeData.basis: All *.db.test.ts use synthetic fixtures; docs/real-world-data/* are controlled fixtures with safety notes, not real client results.
